svg.text: A MONSTER RECORD IN THE LEVEL FILE: 14 BYTES, 30 OF THEM (a record with cell 0 is an empty slot)
spd: speed class 0 or 1 (which pair of update effects); pos 0..3 quadrant, 4 centre; type: row of the type table; alt: second sprite sheet
A LIVE MONSTER, struct Monster, 28 BYTES (gMonsters, ds:8A82, 30 RECORDS = 840 BYTES)
+0 typeIndex: row of the type table; +1 updateGroup 0..3; +2 cell; +4 cellPos (quadrant 0..3, centre 4); +5 orient 0..3
+6 animPhase (walk frame, flips each update); +7 altShapes; +8 mode (0..10); +9 state (wall-follow memory); +A attackFrame (0xFE, 0xFF while swinging); +B
+C maxHp [H], +E hp (dead at 0 or less); +10 targetCell (where it heads); +12, +14 drops; +16 flags: 1 attacked, 2 hit flash, 4 swing, 8 fleeing, 0x10 turn tried
+17 drawOffset (x high nibble, y low; re-rolled by effect 15); +18 actionDelay and +19 actionsLeft (ranged attacks); +1A, +1B read by no code
A MONSTER TYPE, struct MonsterType, 27 BYTES (gMonsterTypes, ds:1A3B, 22 ROWS = 594 BYTES)
+0 armour class (the party's to-hit needs d20 >= 20 - level steps - AC - bonus); +1 the monster's to-hit number (needs d20 >= T0 - the target's armour
class); +2 hit dice (hit points = HD d8, or 1d4 when 255)
+3 number of attacks, then three (count, sides, bonus) dice; +E flags: 1 large-weapon damage, 2 stepping frames, 4 half damage from plain weapons, 8
attacks after moving, 0x10 poison, 0x20 paralysis, 0x40 ranged, 0x80 steals an item
+F bit 0 held by Hold Person, bit 1 by Hold Monster, bit 2 undead; +13 experience; +15 size (nonzero: alone in a cell); +16 hit sound; +17 move sound; +18 ranged
uses (255 = unlimited); +19 turn-undead row (-1 none); +1A magic resistance percent
